purpose: Complete modular scene built around the user's beside-the-tree viewpoint
units: Adopted scene metres; not a measured building
camera_intent: Tree close on the left and overhead, couch leading to the door, open mountain view to the right. Tripod is a metaphor, not a measurement.

tree.sculpt: World-space softened waist and overhead relief, preserving the integral arm and support volume; camera unchanged
tree.right_return: Additional continuous volume behind right jamb, widening by up to 1.10 m at mid-height

rules: Geometry is defined in world coordinates, independently of cameras
Boards and main railing share local X; joists cross at 90 degrees
Timber, bark, cushions, blossoms, lanterns and environment remain separate
Retain original architectural alcove bearing geometry through a rigid placement
Foreground platform boundary is the extent of this room study; adjacent circulation is unfinished
material_revision: Darker irregular bark, lower foreground fill, dense connected canopy, staggered board joints

appearance.bark: Packed CC0 Poly Haven Bark Willow maps, true Cycles displacement and fine bump, curved-limb grain coordinates
appearance.contact_protection: Zero displacement on bearing plane and complete cushion contact faces
appearance.light: B10 reduced interior fill, retained exterior sunset and emissive lantern/fairy lighting; roof shades real scene geometry.
appearance.post_processing: Two Fog Glow passes and saturation 1.12 in Blender
appearance.game_status: Desktop scene; mobile baking and renderer effects still to implement

roof.support_description: Rear header remains on the original posts; wider front beam meets left trunk and diagonal right bearer; knee brace joins the right post to that bearer.
